headline: Approved September 01, 2026 minutes, motor vehicle excise abatements, and statutory exemption applications
summary: The Board of Assessors approved minutes from the September 01, 2026 meeting, approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements by signature, and approved statutory exemption applications under Clauses 17E, 22, 37A, and 41C plus one Veteran Volunteer application. The board also reviewed FY27 certification status, FY27 Q2 warrants and commitments, and the Snow & Ice deficit, with no new or old business.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the September 01, 2026 meeting, unanimous.
Approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements for the week of August 24 to August 28 by signatures.
Approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements for the week of August 31 to September 04 by signatures.
Approved statutory exemption applications: Clause 17E (2), Clause 22 (2), Clause 37A (2), Clause 41C (6), and 1 Veteran Volunteer application, unanimous.
